To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of straight-line drawing algorithms for the hierarchical graph model and the clustered graph model is a viable alternative to the use of straight line drawing algorithms for the classical graph model, and that the use of such algorithms is particularly appropriate for the visualization of large, structured, relational information.
the straight-line drawing algorithms for hierarchical graphs and clustered graphs that we have proposed in this paper are efficient, practical, and effective.
(1) straight-line drawings are a useful model for clustered graphs, and (2) a straight-line drawing of a clustered graph can be computed in O(n log n) time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of efficient and effective algorithms for drawing clustered graphs.
the development and implementation of efficient straight-line drawing algorithms for hierarchical and clustered graphs.
the design and analysis of algorithms for the drawing of graphs and hierarchical graphs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the straight line drawing algorithm is the best algorithm to be used for the drawing of graphs.
the hierarchical graph model is the most appropriate model for the representation of structured relational data, and that it is the most appropriate graph model for graph drawing.
, in order to obtain the best results, the most appropriate graph model must be used, and the most suitable drawing algorithm must be chosen.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed new algorithms for straight-line drawing of clustered graphs and hierarchical graphs, and have implemented them into the software package GUESS.
we developed new algorithms for the problem of computing straight-line drawings of hierarchical and clustered graphs.
we have shown that the straight-line drawing of hierarchical graphs can be computed in linear time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the straight-line drawing algorithm for clustered graphs can be used to produce straight-line drawings for hierarchical graphs.
the hierarchical clustering algorithm is a useful tool for data analysis and data mining.
the graph drawing algorithms we developed for hierarchical graphs and clustered graphs can produce drawings of high quality.
